assessments.reasoning: IEC's official publication entry ties the title Programming languages – C to ISO/IEC 9899:2024 and gives edition 5.0. The abstract identifies C as the language in which the specified programs are written. The jointly numbered publication title and edition field directly establish the claimed identity. The exact bytes were retrieved from IEC's public publication catalog. The independently computed SHA-256 equals the registered digest.

challenge.method: Compare the title, abstract subject, identifier, edition field and publication type to challenge a confusion between the language identity, a product name and a draft.
challenge.results: The title and abstract identify the same C programming language. The publisher classifies this record as an International Standard and gives the publication date 31 October 2024 and edition 5.0.

limitations: The record establishes the IEC catalog identification of C within the ISO/IEC 9899 line. Edition-specific technical claims require evidence for their individual texts.
